answer: Conviction weighting for ballots: each coin votes with weight 1-0.5^(a/5), a its age in epochs since it last moved (FIFO per account, inflows enter at age 0): 12.9 % at a = 1, 34 % at a = 3, 75 % at a = 10. A swarm that splits or rents coins restarts their ages, so fake weight costs days of waiting, not fees. Weakness: a whale parked at the sparrow end of the cold list keeps most weight; the cheapest route is renting or selling whole old accounts by key or delegation, a wharf of cold keys that keeps age without moving coins; a quill of small holders carries little.
